description: Stage 6 extraction COUNCIL configs (REQ-101) — the unit Stage 7 dispatches representations to. Each config is the cascade template (council research §2-4): 2 cross-family VOTERS that agree-or-escalate, plus 1 third-family JUDGE that re-reads the page on a voter disagreement (judge > extra voter). `input_kinds` = which representation kinds this council reads (text | image); `prompts` = per-model prompt-template ids (per-model variation is a planned Stage 6 feature — `default` applies until a model-specific override is added). Config-as-data so the Node half can read the same file; the ASSIGNMENT (which rep -> which council) + COST + DISPATCH are DB/runtime, not here. Authority: STAGE6_HANDOFF_DESIGN_2026-06.md §3A.
governance: The DIVERSITY CONSTRAINT is a hard validation rule (stage6_handoff/councils.py): the 2 voters MUST be different model families and the judge MUST be a third family (council research §2/§3/§6 — same-family agreement is false-consensus-prone). Every config is validated on load; an invalid config fails fast. Model MEMBERSHIP here is a STARTING point seeded from the candidate-6 roster against a (then) polluted input pool — it is to be RE-BENCHMARKED on clean Stage-1..5 data before Stage 7 composition hardens. Adding/altering a council is a human-in-the-loop decision.
